max-w-none"><h1 class="text-large mb-8">Origin API Changelog</h1>
<div class="relative grid w-full grid-cols-[0_1fr] gap-y-0.5 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm has-[&gt;svg]:grid-cols-[calc(var(--spacing)*4)_1fr] has-[&gt;svg]:gap-x-3 [&amp;&gt;svg]:size-4 [&amp;&gt;svg]:translate-y-0.5 [&amp;&gt;svg]:text-current text-card-foreground my-6 items-center border-yellow-200 bg-yellow-50 dark:border-yellow-700 dark:bg-yellow-900/20" data-slot="alert" role="alert"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-triangle-alert h-4 w-4 mb-1 text-yellow-600 dark:text-yellow-400" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m21.73 18-8-14a2 2 0 0 0-3.48 0l-8 14A2 2 0 0 0 4 21h16a2 2 0 0 0 1.73-3"></path><path d="M12 9v4"></path><path d="M12 17h.01"></path></svg><div class="col-start-2 grid justify-items-start gap-1 text-sm [&amp;_p]:mb-0 [&amp;_p]:leading-relaxed text-yellow-700 dark:text-yellow-300" data-slot="alert-description"><p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">The Origin API is in Early Beta and subject to change. Review the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/openapi.yaml">OpenAPI specification</a> when updating an integration.</p></div></div>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Changes to the Origin public API, including endpoints, request and response schemas, scopes, and webhooks, grouped by day with the newest first. Each change carries one label: <strong>Breaking</strong>, <strong>Deprecated</strong>, <strong>Added</strong>, <strong>Changed</strong>, or <strong>Removed</strong>. Breaking and deprecated changes include migration guidance inline. The <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin">Origin API reference</a> always reflects the latest synced state.</p>
<div class="mt-8 flex flex-col"><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="sep-15-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#sep-15-2026" data-heading-base-id="sep-15-2026" aria-label="Copy link to sep-15-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">September 15, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Breaking.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-repo">Create Repo</a> requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">namespace:repositories:create</code></a> in place of <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">namespace:new_repository:write</code>, which no longer authorizes anything and has been removed from the scope catalog. Migration: request <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">namespace:repositories:create</code> on the Cursor user credential wherever your integration requested <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">namespace:new_repository:write</code>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-pull-request-mergeability">Get Pull Request Mergeability</a> returns whether a pull request can be merged and, when it cannot, the typed conditions blocking it: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">GET /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/pulls/{pullNumber}/mergeability</code>. <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">verdict</code> is <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">mergeable</code> or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">blocked</code>, and each entry in <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">blockers</code> carries a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">kind</code>, a human-readable <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">message</code>, and the pull request in <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">evaluatedPullRequests</code> it belongs to, so a stacked pull request&#x27;s verdict covers every pull request from the stack root through it. An optional <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">expectedHeadSha</code> guard returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">Aborted</code> (HTTP 409 Conflict) when the head has moved, and a mirrored repository or a stack of more than 200 pull requests returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">FailedPrecondition</code> (HTTP 400). The operation is published in preview, marked <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">x-cursor-visibility: PREVIEW</code> in the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/openapi.yaml">OpenAPI specification</a>, so decode its responses with unknown fields and unknown enum values tolerated and treat an unrecognized <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">verdict</code> as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">blocked</code>. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:pull_requests:read</code></a> and costs 10 points.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#grep-contents">Grep Contents</a> searches the text of a repository&#x27;s files at a ref and returns the lines that match: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">POST /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}:grep</code>. The body takes a required <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">query</code>, read as a regular expression unless <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">literal</code> is set, plus <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">ref</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">caseInsensitive</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">wholeWord</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">contextBefore</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">contextAfter</code> (values above 10 are reduced to 10), <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">filterPath</code>, the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">includes</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">excludes</code> glob lists (at most 20 entries each), and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">maxResults</code> (default and maximum 1000). Each returned entry is one line, and the response is complete only when <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">limitHit</code> is false; there is no pagination. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:contents:read</code></a> and costs 5 points.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Check-run <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">status</code> has a fourth value, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">rerequested</code>, and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-runs-for-commit">List Check Runs For Commit</a> accepts it as a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">status</code> filter. It marks a completed run whose re-run was asked for and the owning app has not answered yet, so treat it as pending and render it like <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">queued</code>. It appears on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-check-run">Get Check Run</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-runs-for-suite">List Check Runs For Suite</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-runs-for-commit">List Check Runs For Commit</a>, and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#rerequest-check-run">Rerequest Check Run</a>. Only Origin sets it: a <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#post-check-run">Post Check Run</a> or <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#batch-upsert-check-runs">Batch Upsert Check Runs</a> request carrying it returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400).</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-pull-requests">List Pull Requests</a> accepts <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">sortBy</code>, either <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">created</code> (creation order, the default) or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">updated</code> (time of last update). <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">direction</code> sorts along <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">sortBy</code> and still defaults to <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">desc</code>, and a page token carries the sort it was minted under, so a token replayed under the other sort is rejected.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-pull-requests">List Pull Requests</a> accepts <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">state=merged</code>, which lists merged pull requests only. <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">closed</code> keeps covering every pull request that is no longer open, merged ones included, so existing callers see the same results.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#rerequest-check-run">Rerequest Check Run</a> sets the run&#x27;s <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">status</code> to <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">rerequested</code>, superseding the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/changelog#sep-11-2026">September 11</a> note that the call never changes the run&#x27;s own <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">status</code> or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">conclusion</code>. The run&#x27;s <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">conclusion</code> and timings keep describing the superseded attempt, so read <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">conclusion</code> only when <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">status</code> is <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">completed</code>. The run still reads as pending in <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-runs-for-suite">List Check Runs For Suite</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-runs-for-commit">List Check Runs For Commit</a> until the owning app answers, which also clears <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">rerequestedAt</code> and stores the posted status.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> The <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository.check_run.rerequested</code></a> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#check-run-rerequested">payload</a> carries <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">checkRun.status</code> as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">rerequested</code> rather than <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">completed</code>, with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">checkRun.conclusion</code> and the timings still describing the superseded attempt. Migration is the same as for the endpoint: branch on <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">checkRun.status</code> and read <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">checkRun.conclusion</code> only when it is <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">completed</code>.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="sep-12-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#sep-12-2026" data-heading-base-id="sep-12-2026" aria-label="Copy link to sep-12-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">September 12, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="sep-12-2026-pull-requests"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#sep-12-2026-pull-requests" data-heading-base-id="sep-12-2026-pull-requests" aria-label="Copy link to sep-12-2026-pull-requests"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Pull requests</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Breaking.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-pull-request">Create Pull Request</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#update-pull-request">Update Pull Request</a> reject a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">base</code> that does not name an existing branch. A commit SHA, a tag name, or a branch that does not exist returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400) and names the fully qualified ref Origin looked for, where the same request previously created or retargeted the pull request. Such a pull request could never have its merge ref prepared, so CI never received one and the pull request could not be merged. Migration: pass a branch name, short as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">main</code> or fully qualified as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">refs/heads/main</code>, and retarget any existing pull request whose base is a commit SHA or a tag.</li>
</ul><h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="sep-12-2026-apps"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#sep-12-2026-apps" data-heading-base-id="sep-12-2026-apps" aria-label="Copy link to sep-12-2026-apps"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Apps</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-app">Create App</a> registers an app owned by a namespace: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">POST /v1/origin/namespaces/{namespaceSlug}/apps</code>. The body takes a required <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">displayName</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">publicKey</code>, the PEM SPKI Ed25519 public key the app signs its JWTs with, plus optional <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">webhookUrl</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">events</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">description</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">websiteUrl</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">installationRedirectUris</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">defaultScopes</code>. Apps are created private, and an invalid webhook URL, event type, redirect URI, or scope returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400). Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">namespace:apps:create</code></a> on a Cursor user credential and costs 10 points.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-namespace-apps">List Namespace Apps</a> lists the apps a namespace owns, newest first: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">GET /v1/origin/namespaces/{namespaceSlug}/apps</code>. Entries carry display metadata only, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">id</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">displayName</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">description</code>; read one app&#x27;s webhook configuration with <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-app">Get App</a>. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">namespace:apps:read</code></a> and costs 1 point.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-app">Get App</a> returns one app&#x27;s full configuration by id: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">GET /v1/origin/apps/{appId}</code>. This is the publisher&#x27;s management read; <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-authenticated-app">Get Authenticated App</a> remains the self-read an app makes with its own JWT. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">app:settings:read</code></a> and costs 1 point.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#update-app">Update App</a> writes an app&#x27;s settings: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">PATCH /v1/origin/apps/{appId}</code>. <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">displayName</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">webhookUrl</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">description</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">websiteUrl</code> are plain fields, while <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">events</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">installationRedirectUris</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">defaultScopes</code> are clean-replace wrappers that swap the whole list. Omitted fields are left unchanged, a request that sets nothing returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400), and sending <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">webhookUrl</code> as an empty string disables delivery and cancels the app&#x27;s pending deliveries for good. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">app:settings:write</code></a> and costs 5 points.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#add-app-signing-key">Add App Signing Key</a> registers another Ed25519 public key for an app: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">POST /v1/origin/apps/{appId}/signing_keys</code>. The response carries the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">kid</code> to use as the JWT key ID, the base64url-encoded SHA-256 digest of the key&#x27;s SPKI DER encoding. A key that is already registered returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">AlreadyExists</code> (HTTP 409 Conflict), and a key beyond the app&#x27;s active-key limit returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">FailedPrecondition</code> (HTTP 400). Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">app:settings:write</code></a> and costs 5 points.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#revoke-app-signing-key">Revoke App Signing Key</a> retires a signing key and answers <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">204 No Content</code>: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">DELETE /v1/origin/apps/{appId}/signing_keys/{kid}</code>. App JWTs signed with the revoked key stop authenticating, and revoking the last active key returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">FailedPrecondition</code> (HTTP 400). Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">app:settings:write</code></a> and costs 5 points.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> App responses carry <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">namespaceSlug</code>, the slug of the namespace that owns the app, along with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">description</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">websiteUrl</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">defaultScopes</code>. Returned by <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-authenticated-app">Get Authenticated App</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-app">Get App</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-app">Create App</a>, and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#update-app">Update App</a>.</li>
</ul><h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="sep-12-2026-grants"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#sep-12-2026-grants" data-heading-base-id="sep-12-2026-grants" aria-label="Copy link to sep-12-2026-grants"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Grants</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-repository-grants">List Repository Grants</a> lists the users, groups, and owning-team groups holding a permission granted directly on a repository: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">GET /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/grants</code>. Permissions inherited from the repository&#x27;s owner are not included, and a principal that no longer resolves is omitted, so a page can hold fewer grants than <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pageSize</code>. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:settings:read</code></a> and costs 1 point.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#upsert-repository-grant">Upsert Repository Grant</a> sets the permission one principal holds directly on a repository: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">POST /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/grants</code>. The body names exactly one of <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">user</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">group</code>, or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">teamGroup</code> and a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">permission</code> of <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">read</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">write</code>, or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">admin</code>; <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">custom</code> returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400), and a principal outside the owner&#x27;s team or organization returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">FailedPrecondition</code> (HTTP 400). Repeating a grant the principal already holds succeeds without change. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:settings:write</code></a> and costs 5 points.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#delete-repository-grant">Delete Repository Grant</a> removes the permission one principal holds directly on a repository and answers <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">204 No Content</code>: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">DELETE /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/grants</code>. Permissions inherited from the owner are unaffected, so an owning-team group falls back to its owner-level default, and removing a permission the principal does not hold directly succeeds without change. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:settings:write</code></a> and costs 5 points.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-namespace-grants">List Namespace Grants</a> lists who has been granted access to an owner: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">GET /v1/origin/owners/{ownerSlug}/grants</code>. Each grant carries the permission it confers on every repository under the owner, admin grants are listed first, and grants made on individual repositories are excluded. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">namespace:settings:read</code></a> and costs 1 point.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#upsert-namespace-grant">Upsert Namespace Grant</a> sets the permission one principal holds directly on an owner: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">POST /v1/origin/owners/{ownerSlug}/grants</code>. <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">permission</code> takes <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">PERMISSION_READ</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">PERMISSION_CONTRIBUTOR</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">PERMISSION_WRITE</code>, or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">PERMISSION_ADMIN</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">PERMISSION_CUSTOM</code> returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400). A principal outside the owning team or its organization, or a write that would leave the owner without an admin, returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">FailedPrecondition</code> (HTTP 400). Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">namespace:settings:write</code></a> and costs 5 points.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#delete-namespace-grant">Delete Namespace Grant</a> removes the permission one principal holds directly on an owner and answers <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">204 No Content</code>: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">DELETE /v1/origin/owners/{ownerSlug}/grants</code>. Per-repository grants are unaffected, and a removal that would leave the owner without an admin returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">FailedPrecondition</code> (HTTP 400). Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">namespace:settings:write</code></a> and costs 5 points.</li>
</ul><h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="sep-12-2026-installations"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#sep-12-2026-installations" data-heading-base-id="sep-12-2026-installations" aria-label="Copy link to sep-12-2026-installations"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Installations</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Installations carry <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">suspendedAt</code>, set while the installation is suspended and omitted while it is active, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">deletedAt</code>, carried only on the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">installation.deleted</code></a> webhook snapshot. Returned by <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-app-installation">Get App Installation</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-app-installations">List App Installations</a>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> The five <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">installation.*</code></a> payloads carry <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">installation.appId</code>, the same value as the payload&#x27;s own <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">app.id</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">installation.updatedAt</code> on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#installation-created"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">installation.created</code></a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#installation-updated"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">installation.updated</code></a>. Every field of an installation as <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-app-installation">Get App Installation</a> returns it is present on the snapshot under the same name and type, so one decoder reads both.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="sep-11-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#sep-11-2026" data-heading-base-id="sep-11-2026" aria-label="Copy link to sep-11-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">September 11, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="sep-11-2026-check-runs"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#sep-11-2026-check-runs" data-heading-base-id="sep-11-2026-check-runs" aria-label="Copy link to sep-11-2026-check-runs"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Check runs</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Breaking.</strong> The <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository.check_run.rerequested</code></a> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#check-run-rerequested">payload</a> no longer carries a top-level <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">rerequestedBy</code>. The principal that asked for the re-run sits on the embedded check run as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">checkRun.rerequestedBy</code> instead, superseding the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/changelog#sep-10-2026">September 10</a> note that the payload carries the requester beside the repository, suite, and run. Migration: read <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">checkRun.rerequestedBy</code> wherever your receiver read the payload&#x27;s own <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">rerequestedBy</code>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#rerequest-check-run">Rerequest Check Run</a> asks the app that reported a check run to run it again: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">POST /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/check-runs/{checkRunId}/rerequest</code> with an empty body. The run must be <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">completed</code>, must carry <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">isRerequestable</code>, must be the current attempt for its <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">key</code>, and must sit on the current head of an open pull request; anything else returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">FailedPrecondition</code> (HTTP 400), and a second request while one is outstanding returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">AlreadyExists</code> (HTTP 409 Conflict). The call never changes the run&#x27;s own <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">status</code> or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">conclusion</code>. Any principal holding <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:contents:write</code></a> can re-request any re-requestable run, whichever app reported it, and the call costs 5 points.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Check runs carry <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">rerequestedBy</code>, the principal that asked for the re-run, present whenever <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">rerequestedAt</code> is set and cleared together with it. Returned by <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-check-run">Get Check Run</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-runs-for-suite">List Check Runs For Suite</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-runs-for-commit">List Check Runs For Commit</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#post-check-run">Post Check Run</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#batch-upsert-check-runs">Batch Upsert Check Runs</a>, and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#rerequest-check-run">Rerequest Check Run</a>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">rerequestedAt</code> marks an outstanding re-request rather than a one-time stamp. Origin clears it when the owning app answers by posting a fresh run for the same head SHA and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">key</code>, either a new run under a new <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">externalId</code> or an update of the re-requested run under the same one, after which the run can be re-requested again. This supersedes the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/changelog#sep-10-2026">September 10</a> note that a check run is re-requested at most once, so a receiver can see more than one <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository.check_run.rerequested</code></a> event for the same run; keep deduplicating redeliveries on the event id.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> A re-requested check run stays in <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-runs-for-suite">List Check Runs For Suite</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-runs-for-commit">List Check Runs For Commit</a> and reads as pending, with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">rerequestedAt</code> set and its superseded <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">status</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">conclusion</code> unchanged, instead of dropping out of both listings until the app answers. A required check blocks merging as a pending check rather than as a missing one. This supersedes the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/changelog#sep-10-2026">September 10</a> note that the run drops out until a new attempt arrives.</li>
</ul><h3 class="text-base-plus mb-3" id="sep-11-2026-repositories"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#sep-11-2026-repositories" data-heading-base-id="sep-11-2026-repositories" aria-label="Copy link to sep-11-2026-repositories"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">Repositories</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h3><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#update-repo">Update Repo</a> writes repository settings: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">PATCH /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}</code>. The body takes optional <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">defaultBranch</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">allowMergeCommit</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">allowSquashMerge</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">deleteBranchOnMerge</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">visibility</code> fields, and omitted fields are left unchanged. <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">allowMergeCommit</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">allowSquashMerge</code> must be sent together with at least one of them <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">true</code>; <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">defaultBranch</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">deleteBranchOnMerge</code> return <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">FailedPrecondition</code> (HTTP 400) on a repository that pulls from an upstream source; and a request that sets nothing returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400). The groups apply in a fixed order rather than atomically, so a rejected group leaves the groups before it applied. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:settings:write</code></a> and costs 5 points.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/migrations#transition-repo-mirror">Transition Repo Mirror</a> starts a mirror-direction change and returns the job tracking it: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">POST /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/mirror:transition</code>. The body takes a required <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">transition</code> of <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">initial_to_inbound</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">inbound_to_outbound</code>, or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">outbound_to_inbound</code>, and the repository holds a transitioning mirror status while the job runs. A repository that is not in the transition&#x27;s expected start state, or that already has an active job, returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">FailedPrecondition</code> (HTTP 400). Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:mirror:write</code></a> on a Cursor user credential that also administers the repository on the mirror&#x27;s upstream source, and costs 10 points.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/migrations#force-repo-mirror-cutover">Force Repo Mirror Cutover</a> cuts a repository over to its upstream source without pushing divergent state back: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">POST /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/mirror:forceCutover</code> with an empty body. The source is adopted as the source of truth as it stands, and refs that exist only on Origin are snapshotted and abandoned. It is accepted only for a repository in <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">outbound</code> status, or one stuck in an outbound-to-inbound transition whose active job reports <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">requires_attention</code>, which the forced cutover supersedes. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:mirror:write</code></a> and costs 10 points.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/migrations#detach-repo-mirror">Detach Repo Mirror</a> permanently disconnects a mirrored repository from its upstream source and answers <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">204 No Content</code>: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">DELETE /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/mirror</code>. The repository keeps its contents and becomes a native repository, syncing stops in both directions, and the mirror&#x27;s deploy credential is deleted. Detaching an already-detached repository succeeds without effect, while a repository that never had a mirror returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">FailedPrecondition</code> (HTTP 400). Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:mirror:delete</code></a> and costs 5 points.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/migrations#get-mirror-transition-job">Get Mirror Transition Job</a> returns one transition job by id: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">GET /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/mirror/transition-jobs/{jobId}</code>. A job reports its <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">transition</code>, a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">status</code> of <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">queued</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">running</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">succeeded</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">failed_rolled_back</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">requires_attention</code>, or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">superseded</code>, an <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">attemptCount</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">lastErrorCode</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">lastErrorMessage</code> once it has failed. Its <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">phase</code> string is display detail that gains new values as the transition process evolves, so poll <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">status</code> for completion instead of matching on <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">phase</code>. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/migrations#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:metadata:read</code></a> and costs 1 point.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/migrations#get-active-mirror-transition-job">Get Active Mirror Transition Job</a> returns the repository&#x27;s in-progress transition job and its most recent terminal one: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">GET /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/mirror/transition-jobs:active</code>. Both <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">activeJob</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">lastJob</code> are optional, so a repository that has never transitioned returns an empty object, and polling until <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">activeJob</code> disappears and then reading <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">lastJob</code> is what distinguishes a transition that finished from one that never ran. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/migrations#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:metadata:read</code></a> and costs 1 point.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> The mirror-state endpoint references moved to the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/migrations">Origin Migration API</a>. Their HTTP contracts are unchanged, and the previous Origin API anchors link to the new reference.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="sep-10-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#sep-10-2026" data-heading-base-id="sep-10-2026" aria-label="Copy link to sep-10-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">September 10, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#merge-pull-request">Merge Pull Request</a> accepts an optional <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">mergeMethod</code> of <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">merge</code> or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">squash</code>, choosing whether the pull request lands as a merge commit or as a single squash commit. A method the repository does not allow is rejected with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">FailedPrecondition</code> (HTTP 400), and any other value, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">rebase</code> included, with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400). Omit it to keep the previous behavior: a merge commit when the repository allows one, otherwise a squash, and a squash when the base branch requires linear history.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Repository payloads carry <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">visibility</code>, which is <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">internal</code> or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">private</code>, along with the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">allowMergeCommit</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">allowSquashMerge</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">deleteBranchOnMerge</code> booleans. All four are read-only and are returned by <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-repo">Get Repo</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-repo">Create Repo</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-repos">List Repos</a>, and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-app-installation-repositories">List App Installation Repositories</a>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Check runs carry <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">isRerequestable</code>, the reporting app&#x27;s declaration that the run can be run again, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">rerequestedAt</code>, the timestamp of the re-request. Send <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">isRerequestable</code> on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#post-check-run">Post Check Run</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#batch-upsert-check-runs">Batch Upsert Check Runs</a>; both fields come back there and on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-check-run">Get Check Run</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-runs-for-suite">List Check Runs For Suite</a>, and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-runs-for-commit">List Check Runs For Commit</a>. Declaring a run re-requestable commits your app to answering each re-request by posting a new run for the same head SHA and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">key</code>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository.check_run.rerequested</code></a> is delivered when a completed check run is re-requested, and it reaches only the app that owns the run rather than every subscriber to the repository. Its <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#check-run-rerequested">payload</a> carries the repository, the check suite, the stamped check run, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">rerequestedBy</code>, and it carries no pull request context, so resolve the pull request from <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">checkRun.sha</code>. Subscribing takes <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:checks:read</code></a>. A check run is re-requested at most once, so deduplicate redeliveries on the event id.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Every webhook payload schema in the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/openapi.yaml">OpenAPI specification</a> carries an <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">x-origin-webhook-events</code> extension naming the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events">events</a> it is delivered with, plus a curated sample payload as its schema <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">example</code>, and the new <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#event-payloads">Event payloads</a> reference documents each payload&#x27;s fields and sample payload, generated from those schemas in the same layout as the endpoint reference.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> A re-requested check run drops out of <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-runs-for-suite">List Check Runs For Suite</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-runs-for-commit">List Check Runs For Commit</a> until the app that owns it posts a new attempt or refreshes the existing one with a newer <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">externalUpdatedAt</code>. A required check therefore reads as missing and blocks merging while the re-request is outstanding. Read the excluded run by its own id with <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-check-run">Get Check Run</a>.</li>
