</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="sep-9-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#sep-9-2026" data-heading-base-id="sep-9-2026" aria-label="Copy link to sep-9-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">September 9, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Breaking.</strong> An <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">inline</code> anchor whose line range runs past the end of the file is rejected with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400) on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-pull-request-comment">Create Pull Request Comment</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-pull-request-review">Create Pull Request Review</a>. The range is still not restricted to the diff&#x27;s hunks, and it is checked against the file as it exists on the anchored side, which <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">left</code> reads at the base commit and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">right</code> at the head; the error names the file&#x27;s line count. On a review, one out-of-range anchor fails the whole request and publishes nothing. Migration: bound <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">inline.startLine</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">inline.endLine</code> to the anchored side&#x27;s line count before writing, reading it from <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-contents">Get Contents</a> when the anchor sits outside the diff&#x27;s hunks.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="sep-5-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#sep-5-2026" data-heading-base-id="sep-5-2026" aria-label="Copy link to sep-5-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">September 5, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-git-ref">Create Git Ref</a> creates a branch at an existing commit: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">POST /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/git/refs</code>. It takes <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">ref</code> as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">refs/heads/&lt;branch&gt;</code> or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">heads/&lt;branch&gt;</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">sha</code> as the full hex SHA of a commit in the repository; tags and other reference namespaces return <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400). Creating a branch that already points at <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">sha</code> returns the existing reference, and a branch that exists at another commit returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">AlreadyExists</code> (HTTP 409 Conflict). Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:contents:write</code></a> and costs 5 points.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-commit-from-files">Create Commit From Files</a> commits inline file changes to a branch and advances it: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">POST /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/git/commits:createFromFiles</code>. Each <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">files[]</code> entry sets exactly one of <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">content</code> (with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">encoding</code> <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">utf-8</code> or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">base64</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">mode</code> <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">file</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">executable</code>, or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">symlink</code>) and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">delete</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">expectedHeadSha</code> must match the branch tip, which becomes the new commit&#x27;s parent. The response returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">sha</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">treeSha</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">previousHeadSha</code>. One request carries at most 1,000 file changes, 8 MiB per file, and 32 MiB of content in total. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:contents:write</code></a> and costs 10 points.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> Webhook delivery retries a failed send seven times instead of six, and the first retry lands 5 seconds after the failure rather than 30 seconds. The full ladder is 5 seconds, 30 seconds, 1 minute, 2 minutes, 4 minutes, and 8 minutes, so a receiver that is down the whole time sees one more <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">POST</code> over roughly the same 16-minute window. Deduplicate the extra attempt on <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">webhook-id</code> the same way you deduplicate the rest.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="sep-4-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#sep-4-2026" data-heading-base-id="sep-4-2026" aria-label="Copy link to sep-4-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">September 4, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Breaking.</strong> App metadata no longer carries <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">slug</code>. It is gone from the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-authenticated-app">Get Authenticated App</a> response, from every app actor that check, pull request, review, and comment operations return (<code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">actor.app</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">author.app</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">dismissal.dismissedBy.app</code>), from the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">app</code> object on the five <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">installation.*</code></a> webhook payloads, and from the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#ping-webhook">Ping Webhook</a> payload, superseding the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/changelog#sep-2-2026">September 2</a> note that app actors carry <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">displayName</code> alongside <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">id</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">slug</code>. An app actor was previously guaranteed to carry <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">slug</code>; it now carries <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">id</code> and the optional <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">displayName</code>. Migration: address apps by <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">id</code> and label them with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">displayName</code> wherever your integration read <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">slug</code>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-pull-request-comments">List Pull Request Comments</a> accepts an optional <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">threadIds</code> query parameter that restricts the listing to comments in those threads, which is how you read one thread without paging a pull request&#x27;s whole comment history. Duplicates are ignored, so the limit of 20 applies to distinct IDs, and a longer list or an empty ID returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400). Page tokens embed the set they were minted under, so restart pagination when the filter changes.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> The <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">author</code> filter on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-pull-requests">List Pull Requests</a> also accepts the exact email address of a user, matched case-insensitively, alongside the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">user_…</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">app_…</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">sa_…</code> actor IDs it already took. An email that resolves to no single user returns an empty list rather than an error, and an email previously returned <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400). Apps and service accounts have no email identity, so only user authors can be selected that way, and actor IDs remain the identity these responses return.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="sep-3-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#sep-3-2026" data-heading-base-id="sep-3-2026" aria-label="Copy link to sep-3-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">September 3, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-runs-for-commit">List Check Runs For Commit</a> accepts optional <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">checkName</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">status</code> query parameters. <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">checkName</code> matches a check run&#x27;s <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">name</code> exactly, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">status</code> takes <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">queued</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">in_progress</code>, or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">completed</code>; any other value returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400). Both filters apply after the latest-attempt collapse, so a run matches on its latest attempt&#x27;s status and a filter never resurfaces a superseded attempt. Page tokens embed the filters they were minted under, so restart pagination when a filter changes.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-pull-request-comments">List Pull Request Comments</a> accepts optional <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">since</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">until</code> query parameters, inclusive bounds on comment creation time as RFC 3339 timestamps such as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">2026-08-01T00:00:00Z</code>. A malformed timestamp returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400). Page tokens embed the bounds they were minted under, so restart pagination when a bound changes. Track new comments with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">since</code> instead of re-paging a pull request&#x27;s whole comment history.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> An operation whose required scopes come with the credential rather than from an installation grant marks its <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">x-origin-scopes</code> extension <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">ambient: true</code> in the published <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/openapi.yaml">OpenAPI specification</a>. Nine operations carry the flag, among them <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-authenticated-app">Get Authenticated App</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-installation-access-token">Create Installation Access Token</a>, and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-app-installation-repositories">List App Installation Repositories</a>. The scope strings stay in the extension so <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">403</code> responses still name them, and request handling is unchanged; read the flag to tell an operation you only have to authenticate for from one that needs a <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes">scope</a> approved at installation.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="sep-2-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#sep-2-2026" data-heading-base-id="sep-2-2026" aria-label="Copy link to sep-2-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">September 2, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Breaking.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-suites-for-commit">List Check Suites For Commit</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-runs-for-commit">List Check Runs For Commit</a>, and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-runs-for-suite">List Check Runs For Suite</a> return only the latest attempt of each check and omit superseded attempts, matching what the merge gate and the product CI views already showed. A suite collapses to its latest attempt per reporting actor and suite key, and a run to its latest attempt per run key within a suite, so a failed run and its successful retry no longer both appear. <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">totalSize</code> and page tokens count the collapsed set. Migration: read a superseded attempt by its own id through <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-check-run">Get Check Run</a> or <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-check-suite">Get Check Suite</a>, which still address every stored attempt.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-pull-request-comment">Create Pull Request Comment</a> accepts a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">file</code> anchor that opens a comment thread on a whole file in the pull request version&#x27;s diff. It carries <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">file.path</code> alone: Origin derives the side from the file&#x27;s change kind, the base version for a deleted file and the head version otherwise, and returns it on <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">thread.side</code>. Send the deleted path for a deletion and the head path for every other change; a path outside the diff or a renamed file&#x27;s pre-rename source path returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400). <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">file</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">inline</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">threadId</code> are mutually exclusive. <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-pull-request-review">Create Pull Request Review</a> takes the same anchor as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">comments[].file</code>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Public user actors carry <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">displayName</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">handle</code> alongside <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">id</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">email</code>. <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">displayName</code> is the account&#x27;s first and last name joined with a space, the same name the product renders, and is omitted when the account has no name. <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">handle</code> is the claimed profile handle without the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">@</code> prefix, present only while that profile is publicly visible. Both appear wherever a user actor does, including pull request and comment authors, check run and suite actors, review dismissals, requested reviewers, an installation&#x27;s <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">installedBy</code>, and the matching webhook payloads. The <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#installation-receipt">installation receipt</a> carries <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">displayName</code> and never <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">handle</code>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Public app actors carry the app&#x27;s registered <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">displayName</code> alongside <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">id</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">slug</code>, and the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">app</code> object on the five <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">installation.*</code></a> webhook payloads carries it too. It is omitted when the app cannot be resolved and on Cursor&#x27;s first-party managed actor.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> Requesting a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">:write</code> scope also grants the matching <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">:read</code> scope, so an installation asking for <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:labels:write</code></a> is granted <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:labels:read</code> with it. This applies when an app is installed, when an installation is previewed, and when an installation access token attenuates its scopes, and an existing write-only credential now permits the matching read. Read scopes still never grant writes.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="sep-1-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#sep-1-2026" data-heading-base-id="sep-1-2026" aria-label="Copy link to sep-1-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">September 1, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository.deleted</code></a> delivers when a repository is deleted, whether through a product delete of a native or outbound repository or by stopping the sync on an inbound mirror. The payload carries a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository</code> reference and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">deletedAt</code> rather than a snapshot, because a deleted repository no longer resolves through the API. Subscribing requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:metadata:read</code></a>. Unlike <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository.pushed</code></a>, this event is delivered for repositories mirrored from GitHub, since stopping the sync deletes only the Cursor-side repository and GitHub sends nothing for it. A repeated delete of an already-deleted repository emits nothing.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository.metadata.updated</code></a> delivers when a repository&#x27;s default branch changes, covering settings and API writes, an inbound mirror following an upstream rename, and first-push trunk reconciliation. The payload carries the full post-write <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository</code> snapshot with no delta and no updating actor, so compare successive snapshots or refetch the repository to see what moved. Subscribing requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:metadata:read</code></a>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Requested-reviewer users carry an <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">email</code> alongside <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">id</code>. It appears on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-pull-request-requested-reviewers">List Pull Request Requested Reviewers</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#request-pull-request-reviewers">Request Pull Request Reviewers</a>, and on the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">reviewer.user</code> entry of the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pull_request.reviewer.added</code></a>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pull_request.reviewer.removed</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pull_request.reviewer.rerequested</code> webhooks. The value is the account email address, and it is empty when the account has none. These surfaces previously identified a user by id alone.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> REST responses carry fields that sit at their default value instead of dropping them, so a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">false</code> boolean, a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">0</code> number, an empty string, and an empty array are present in every response body. A non-draft pull request from <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-pull-request">Get Pull Request</a> reports <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">draft</code> as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">false</code> rather than omitting it, and an empty list reports <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">[]</code> rather than nothing at all. Fields the contract marks optional, such as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">submitted_at</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">dismissal</code>, stay absent when unset. Read the value itself wherever your integration treated a missing key as the default. This matches how webhook payloads have always serialized.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> Each operation in the published <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/openapi.yaml">OpenAPI specification</a> carries a unique <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">operationId</code>. Where one operation answers two URL shapes, the second shape takes a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">_2</code> suffix: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">OriginService_GetRepoTarball_2</code> for <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">GET …/tarball/{ref}</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">OriginService_ListMatchingGitRefs_2</code> for <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">GET …/git/matching-refs</code>. Both URL shapes and their request handling are unchanged, so regenerate any client built from the specification to pick up the renamed methods.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">installation.updated</code></a> also delivers when the owner namespace is renamed, once for each installation the namespace still holds. The event carries the new namespace slug along with that installation&#x27;s current scopes and repository selection.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="aug-31-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#aug-31-2026" data-heading-base-id="aug-31-2026" aria-label="Copy link to aug-31-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">August 31, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> Every operation in the published <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/openapi.yaml">OpenAPI specification</a> carries an <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">x-origin-scopes</code> extension that names the scope the operation requires and the credentials it accepts. <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">scopes</code> holds the required scope, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">tokenTypes</code> holds the accepted credential kinds: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">app</code> for an app JWT, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">installation</code> for an installation access token, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">user</code> for a user credential. A credential kind the operation rejects is absent from <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">tokenTypes</code>, and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-rate-limit">Get Rate Limit</a> is the one operation that requires no scope. The extension also replaced the scope sentences that <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-label">Create Label</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#update-label">Update Label</a>, and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#delete-label">Delete Label</a> carried in their descriptions. Authorization is unchanged; the extension publishes the scopes Origin already enforced.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="aug-29-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#aug-29-2026" data-heading-base-id="aug-29-2026" aria-label="Copy link to aug-29-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">August 29, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-pull-request-requested-reviewers">List Pull Request Requested Reviewers</a> returns the users and groups whose review is outstanding on a pull request: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">GET /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/pulls/{pullNumber}/requested_reviewers</code>. A direct request clears when that user submits a review, and a group request clears when any current member of the group submits, while an unsubmitted draft review leaves the request pending. Reviewers come back as ids, and reading them requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:pull_requests:reviews:read</code></a>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#request-pull-request-reviewers">Request Pull Request Reviewers</a> requests reviews from users and groups and returns the reviewers it requested: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">POST /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/pulls/{pullNumber}/requested_reviewers</code>. Identify each reviewer by public <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">user_…</code> id, email, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">grp_…</code> id, or group slug; display names do not resolve, an unknown or ambiguous identifier returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400), and a reviewer who is not a candidate for the repository returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">PermissionDenied</code> (HTTP 403). Requesting an already-requested reviewer bumps the request, so a reviewer who had submitted a review reappears as pending. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:pull_requests:reviews:write</code></a>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#remove-pull-request-requested-reviewers">Remove Pull Request Requested Reviewers</a> drops outstanding review requests and returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">204</code> with an empty body: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">DELETE /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/pulls/{pullNumber}/requested_reviewers</code>. Removing a reviewer who is not currently requested is a no-op, and a stable public id still resolves after that reviewer leaves the repository&#x27;s candidate list, so a stale request can be cleared. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:pull_requests:reviews:write</code></a>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#update-pull-request-thread">Update Pull Request Thread</a> resolves or reopens a pull request comment thread and returns its updated state: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">PATCH /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/pulls/threads/{threadId}</code>. Send <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">resolved</code> as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">true</code> to resolve and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">false</code> to reopen. Both directions are idempotent, replying to a resolved thread does not reopen it, and a thread stored on another repository returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">404</code>. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:pull_requests:reviews:write</code></a>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Pull request comments carry their full thread in place of a bare thread id. <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">thread</code> gained the filed-against <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">version</code> with its head and base SHAs, the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">path</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">side</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">startLine</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">endLine</code> of the thread&#x27;s diff anchor, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">resolvedAt</code>, and the thread&#x27;s own <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">createdAt</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">updatedAt</code>. Returned by <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-pull-request-comments">List Pull Request Comments</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-pull-request-comment">Get Pull Request Comment</a>, and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#update-pull-request-comment">Update Pull Request Comment</a>. <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">thread.id</code> is unchanged, so grouping comments by it keeps working.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-pull-request-comment">Create Pull Request Comment</a> accepts an <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">inline</code> anchor, made of <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">path</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">side</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">startLine</code>, and an optional <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">endLine</code>, that opens a line-anchored thread on a pull request version&#x27;s diff, plus a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">versionNumber</code> naming the version to file against that defaults to the latest at call time. The <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">path</code> must be part of that version&#x27;s diff on a side the file has content on, any line of a changed file anchors rather than only lines inside a diff hunk, and an invalid anchor returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400) instead of falling back to a general-discussion comment. <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">inline</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">threadId</code> are mutually exclusive, as are <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">threadId</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">versionNumber</code>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-pull-request-review">Create Pull Request Review</a> accepts a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">comments</code> array, at most 50 per request, that publishes a review together with its comments in one atomic call. Each entry carries a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">body</code> plus the same targets as <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-pull-request-comment">Create Pull Request Comment</a>: an <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">inline</code> anchor on the reviewed version&#x27;s diff, a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">threadId</code> reply, or neither for a new general-discussion thread. Every anchor is validated before anything is written, so a single bad anchor fails the whole request with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400) and publishes nothing. The operation carries no idempotency key, so read <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-pull-request-reviews">List Pull Request Reviews</a> before retrying an ambiguous failure. A request without <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">comments</code> behaves as it did.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pull_request.comment.created</code></a> carries the thread&#x27;s diff anchor on the comment that opened the thread, so a receiver can materialize the thread without a follow-up read. <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">comment.thread</code> holds the filed-against <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">version</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">path</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">side</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">startLine</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">endLine</code>; a reply carries <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">comment.thread.id</code> alone, and resolution state stays out of the event. Comments filed with a review through <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-pull-request-review">Create Pull Request Review</a> emit nothing until the review submits, and then each one emits its own event.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="aug-28-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#aug-28-2026" data-heading-base-id="aug-28-2026" aria-label="Copy link to aug-28-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">August 28, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-repo-tarball">Get Repo Tarball</a> downloads a gzip-compressed tar of a repository tree: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">GET /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/tarball/{ref}</code>. The first request for a resolved commit streams <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">application/gzip</code> as the response body; later requests for the same commit return <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">302</code> with a signed download URL in <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">Location</code>, valid for 15 minutes. Archive entries sit at the root of the tar with no wrapping directory, an empty repository returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">ABORTED</code> (HTTP 409 Conflict), and downloading an archive requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:contents:read</code></a>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-comparison-files">List Comparison Files</a> lists the files a comparison changed, the diff of <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">head</code> against the merge base of <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">base</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">head</code>: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">GET /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/compare/{basehead}/files</code>. Results are paginated, 30 files per page by default and at most 100, and each file carries the shape <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-commit-files">List Commit Files</a> returns. An <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">identical</code> or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">behind</code> comparison returns an empty list, unrelated histories return <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">404</code>, and a comparison whose commits move mid-pagination rejects the page token with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400) so listing restarts from the first page. Reading comparison files requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:contents:read</code></a>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> The <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#discovery-and-signing-keys">signing key endpoint</a> sends <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">Cache-Control: public, max-age=600, stale-if-error=600</code>. Reuse a cached JWKS for 10 minutes, then refresh; when a refresh fails, keep the last good keys for at most another 10 minutes before failing verification. Refresh on a signature no active key verifies so a retired key ID drops out.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> A check run still <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">in_progress</code> when its <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">deadlineAt</code> passes completes with a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">timed_out</code> conclusion and delivers <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository.check_run.completed</code></a>, superseding the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/changelog#aug-27-2026">August 27</a> note that a deadline does not change a run&#x27;s status. Expiry runs as a periodic sweep rather than a per-run timer, so a run can sit past its deadline briefly. A <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">queued</code> run never expires, nor does a run carrying no <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">deadlineAt</code>, and Origin leaves the run&#x27;s <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">externalUpdatedAt</code> in place so a later completion from your provider can overwrite the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">timed_out</code> conclusion.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository.pushed</code></a> is not delivered for a repository Origin mirrors from GitHub. GitHub owns those pushes and sends its own push webhooks, so the Origin delivery duplicated them. Pushes to native Origin repositories and to outbound mirrors are delivered unchanged, and mirror state affects no other event.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-pull-request">Create Pull Request</a> rejects a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">head</code> with no history in common with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">base</code> with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400) and creates nothing, in place of the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">404</code> the underlying comparison surfaced.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> A push that leaves an open pull request&#x27;s head with no history in common with its base closes the pull request and delivers <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pull_request.closed</code></a>. A later related push does not reopen it.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> Each operation in the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/openapi.yaml">OpenAPI specification</a> documents the response codes that operation can return, in place of a uniform <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">400</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">401</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">403</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">429</code> on every operation: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">404</code> on every parameterized path, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">409</code> wherever a handler reports a conflict, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">202</code> on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#batch-redeliver-webhook-deliveries">Batch Redeliver Webhook Deliveries</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#sync-mirror">Sync Mirror</a>, and shorter sets on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-rate-limit">Get Rate Limit</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-authenticated-app">Get Authenticated App</a>. The <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">Status</code> schema describes the error envelope Origin returns, including that a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">404</code> never distinguishes a missing resource from an unreachable one, and every operation carries a request and response example. Request handling is unchanged; regenerate any client built from the spec to pick up the new response models.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="aug-27-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#aug-27-2026" data-heading-base-id="aug-27-2026" aria-label="Copy link to aug-27-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">August 27, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Check runs accept and return an optional <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">deadlineAt</code> timestamp. Send it in the run body on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#post-check-run">Post Check Run</a> or <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#batch-upsert-check-runs">Batch Upsert Check Runs</a>, and read it back on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-check-run">Get Check Run</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-runs-for-suite">List Check Runs For Suite</a>, and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-runs-for-commit">List Check Runs For Commit</a>. Origin clears the deadline once the run reaches <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">completed</code>, leaves the stored value unchanged when an update omits the field, and rejects a deadline more than 24 hours in the future with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400) rather than clamping it. A deadline does not change the run&#x27;s status when it passes.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> The published <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/openapi.yaml">OpenAPI specification</a> declares <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">https://api.cursor.com</code> as its server and a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">bearerAuth</code> HTTP bearer security scheme, so a client generated from the document picks up the base URL and the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">Authorization: Bearer</code> requirement.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> OpenAPI path parameters carry the names the URLs already use. The generated <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">identifier.ownerSlug</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">identifier.name</code> bindings became <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">ownerSlug</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repoName</code> across all 55 repository-scoped operations, which lets standard OpenAPI generators consume the document. Request URLs and request behavior are unchanged; regenerate any client built from the spec to pick up the new parameter names.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> Published enums no longer list their <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">*_UNSPECIFIED</code> zero-value entries, such as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">RULESET_ENFORCEMENT_UNSPECIFIED</code> on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-ruleset">Create Ruleset</a> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">PULL_REQUEST_REVIEW_VERDICT_UNSPECIFIED</code> on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-pull-request-review">Create Pull Request Review</a>. Origin never accepted or returned those values, so requests and responses are unchanged.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> Every operation in the spec documents <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">400</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">401</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">403</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">429</code> responses carrying the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">google.rpc.Status</code> body, in place of the catch-all <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">default</code> response alone. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#errors">Errors</a> for the body and the full status list.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="aug-26-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#aug-26-2026" data-heading-base-id="aug-26-2026" aria-label="Copy link to aug-26-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">August 26, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
