The generated <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">identifier.ownerSlug</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">identifier.name</code> bindings became <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">ownerSlug</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repoName</code> across all 55 repository-scoped operations, which lets standard OpenAPI generators consume the document. Request URLs and request behavior are unchanged; regenerate any client built from the spec to pick up the new parameter names.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> Published enums no longer list their <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">*_UNSPECIFIED</code> zero-value entries, such as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">RULESET_ENFORCEMENT_UNSPECIFIED</code> on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-ruleset">Create Ruleset</a> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">PULL_REQUEST_REVIEW_VERDICT_UNSPECIFIED</code> on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-pull-request-review">Create Pull Request Review</a>. Origin never accepted or returned those values, so requests and responses are unchanged.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> Every operation in the spec documents <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">400</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">401</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">403</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">429</code> responses carrying the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">google.rpc.Status</code> body, in place of the catch-all <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">default</code> response alone. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#errors">Errors</a> for the body and the full status list.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="aug-26-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#aug-26-2026" data-heading-base-id="aug-26-2026" aria-label="Copy link to aug-26-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">August 26, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Breaking.</strong> Reviewer <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#event-payloads">webhook payloads</a> for <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pull_request.reviewer.added</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pull_request.reviewer.removed</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pull_request.reviewer.rerequested</code> replace the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">reviewer.kind</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">reviewer.id</code> pair with a typed reviewer, where exactly one of <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">reviewer.user</code> or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">reviewer.group</code> is present. Migration: read <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">reviewer.user.id</code> where you read <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">reviewer.id</code> with a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">reviewer.kind</code> of <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">user</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">reviewer.group.id</code> where <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">reviewer.kind</code> was <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">group</code>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-labels">List Labels</a> returns the label definitions a repository owns, ordered by name: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">GET /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/labels</code>. Reading labels requires the new <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:labels:read</code></a> scope. Results are paginated, 30 labels per page by default and at most 100.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-label">Create Label</a> defines a label on a repository and returns it: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">POST /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/labels</code>. Every label write requires the new <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:labels:write</code></a> scope. <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">name</code> is capped at 50 characters and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">description</code> at 255, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">color</code> must be six hexadecimal characters without a leading <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">#</code>, and a name another label on the repository already uses is rejected with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">AlreadyExists</code> (HTTP 409 Conflict).</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-label">Get Label</a> returns one repository label by name: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">GET /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/labels/{labelName}</code>. An unknown name returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">404</code>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#delete-label">Delete Label</a> deletes a repository label by name and returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">204</code>: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">DELETE /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/labels/{labelName}</code>. Deleting a label also removes it from every pull request it was assigned to.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#update-label">Update Label</a> changes a label&#x27;s name, color, or description, addressing it by its current name: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">PATCH /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/labels/{labelName}</code>. Omitted fields are left unchanged, and renaming to a name another label already uses is rejected with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">AlreadyExists</code> (HTTP 409 Conflict).</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-check-run-annotations">List Check Run Annotations</a> returns a check run&#x27;s annotations in ascending ID order, which is also creation order: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">GET /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/check-runs/{checkRunId}/annotations</code>. Reading them requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:checks:read</code></a>. Results are paginated, 30 annotations per page by default and at most 100.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-check-run-annotations">Create Check Run Annotations</a> appends between 1 and 25 annotations to a check run in one atomic batch and returns them: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">POST /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/check-runs/{checkRunId}/annotations</code>. Appending requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:checks:write</code></a>. A check run holds at most 100 annotations, and a batch that would exceed that is rejected with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">ResourceExhausted</code> (HTTP 429) without writing anything. The operation is append-only and not idempotent, so a retry after an ambiguous failure can append duplicates.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-pull-requests">List Pull Requests</a> takes five more query parameters: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">author</code>, a public actor ID exactly as the response returns it in <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pullRequests[].author.user.id</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pullRequests[].author.app.id</code>, or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pullRequests[].author.serviceAccount.id</code>; <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">base</code>, an exact base-branch filter that accepts a short name or a fully qualified ref; <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">direction</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">desc</code> for newest first (the default) or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">asc</code> for oldest first; and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">since</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">until</code>, inclusive RFC 3339 bounds on creation time. An author with no pull requests returns an empty list, and any other unusable value returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400).</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pull_request.review.dismissed</code></a> is delivered when a submitted review is dismissed, whether explicitly or by being superseded by a newer decision. It carries the same <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#event-payloads">payload shape</a> as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pull_request.review.submitted</code> with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">review.dismissal</code> populated, and subscribing to it needs <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:pull_requests:reviews:read</code></a>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Installations name the user who installed the app. <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">installedBy</code>, carrying that user&#x27;s public <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">user_…</code> ID and email, is returned by <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-app-installation">Get App Installation</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-app-installations">List App Installations</a> and rides every <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">installation.*</code> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#event-payloads">webhook snapshot</a>; there it identifies the original installer and is omitted when that user record can no longer be read. The <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#installation-receipt">installation receipt</a> gains an <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">installedBy</code> claim naming the user who performed that install or re-consent, so after a re-consent the two can differ.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="aug-25-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#aug-25-2026" data-heading-base-id="aug-25-2026" aria-label="Copy link to aug-25-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">August 25, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#ping-webhook">Ping Webhook</a> sends a test delivery to your app&#x27;s configured webhook URL and reports what the receiver answered: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">POST /v1/origin/app/webhook/pings</code>. The delivery is signed like a production one, carries <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">webhook-event-type</code> of <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">ping</code>, and belongs to no installation. Origin sends it once with no retries, and it never appears in <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-webhook-deliveries">List Webhook Deliveries</a>. An app with no webhook URL configured is rejected with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">FailedPrecondition</code> (HTTP 400).</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Error responses carry the request ID twice: an <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">X-Request-ID</code> response header, and a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">google.rpc.RequestInfo</code> entry in <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">details</code>. Origin echoes the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">x-request-id</code> you sent or generates one when you send none, and includes the entry even when the message is an opaque internal error. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#errors">Errors</a>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-pull-request">Create Pull Request</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#update-pull-request">Update Pull Request</a> reject a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">title</code> longer than 256 characters, or a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">body</code> longer than 65,536 characters, with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400). Values past those lengths previously failed with an internal error. Both limits count Unicode code points, so an astral character such as an emoji counts once.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#sync-mirror">Sync Mirror</a> responses always carry <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">synced</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">true</code> or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">false</code>, mirroring the HTTP status: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">200</code> when true, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">202</code> when false. The field was previously omitted when false, so callers had to read an absent field as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">false</code>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> Unmatched paths under <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">/v1/origin</code>, and requests that use the wrong method on a known path, return the documented <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#errors">error envelope</a> rather than a generic router body. The message names the method and path and never echoes the query string.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> Merging a pull request delivers a <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository.pushed</code></a> webhook for the base ref the merge advances. Origin performs that push itself, so the event names no pusher. Base-ref updates from a merge were previously not delivered.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="aug-24-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#aug-24-2026" data-heading-base-id="aug-24-2026" aria-label="Copy link to aug-24-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">August 24, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-pull-request-comment">Create Pull Request Comment</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#update-pull-request-comment">Update Pull Request Comment</a> reject a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">body</code> longer than 65,536 characters with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400). A body past that length previously failed with an internal error. The limit counts Unicode code points, so an astral character such as an emoji counts once.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="aug-22-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#aug-22-2026" data-heading-base-id="aug-22-2026" aria-label="Copy link to aug-22-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">August 22, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#delete-ruleset">Delete Ruleset</a> deletes a repository ruleset by its stable Origin ID and returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">204</code>: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">DELETE /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/rulesets/{rulesetId}</code>. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:rulesets:write</code></a>. A ruleset stored on a different repository reads as an unknown ruleset, and an empty <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">rulesetId</code> is rejected with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400).</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Every repository-scoped endpoint addresses a repository by its stable ID as well as by owner and name: send <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">_</code> as the owner slug and the ID as the repository name, as in <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">GET /v1/origin/repos/_/REPO_ID</code>. Read the ID from <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">id</code> on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-repo">Get Repo</a>. The ID survives a rename but grants nothing on its own, so your app needs the same scope on the resolved repository, and an ID it cannot reach returns the same <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">404</code> as an ID that does not exist. <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-repo">Create Repo</a> takes an owner slug alone and rejects <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">_</code>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> Apps reach mirrored repositories. A mirror can be selected into an installation, appears in <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-app-installation-repositories">List App Installation Repositories</a> and in the installation <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#event-payloads">webhook payload</a> repository arrays, can be named in <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repositoryIds</code> on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-installation-access-token">Create Installation Access Token</a>, and receives webhook deliveries. Until a mirror becomes a stable outbound mirror it stays read-only: only <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:metadata:read</code></a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:contents:read</code></a> apply, and every other scope returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">403</code> on that repository, including <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">git push</code>. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#mirrored-repositories">Mirrored repositories</a>.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="aug-21-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#aug-21-2026" data-heading-base-id="aug-21-2026" aria-label="Copy link to aug-21-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">August 21, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Breaking.</strong> The <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">recursive</code> query parameter on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-tree">Get Tree</a> is a boolean rather than a string, so only <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">true</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">1</code> walk the whole tree; every other value, including <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">false</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">0</code>, and a bare <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">?recursive</code>, lists immediate children only. Migration: send <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">recursive=true</code> wherever your integration relied on any non-empty <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">recursive</code> value enabling recursion.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Breaking.</strong> Pull request lifecycle <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#event-payloads">webhook payloads</a> omit the pull request&#x27;s assigned <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">labels</code>, superseding the field announced on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/changelog#aug-20-2026">August 20, 2026</a>. REST responses still carry it. Migration: read labels from <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-pull-request">Get Pull Request</a> or <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-pull-requests">List Pull Requests</a> instead of the webhook snapshot.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-rulesets">List Rulesets</a> returns every ruleset configured on a repository plus one shared <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository</code> reference: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">GET /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/rulesets</code>. Rulesets are bounded configuration, so the response is not paginated. Reading rulesets requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:rulesets:read</code></a>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-ruleset">Create Ruleset</a> stores a new ruleset and returns it with the IDs Origin assigns to each rule and bypass actor: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">POST /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/rulesets</code>. Both ruleset write endpoints require <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:rulesets:write</code></a>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-ruleset">Get Ruleset</a> returns a single ruleset by its stable Origin ID: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">GET /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/rulesets/{rulesetId}</code>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#update-ruleset">Update Ruleset</a> replaces a ruleset&#x27;s configuration in full, including its <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">rules</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">bypassActors</code>: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">PUT /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/rulesets/{rulesetId}</code>. Send every rule and bypass actor you want to keep, because the stored entries are replaced rather than merged.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Rulesets carry <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">id</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">name</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">description</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">enforcement</code> (<code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">active</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">evaluate</code>, or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">disabled</code>), <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">kind</code> (<code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">merge_branch</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">push_branch</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">push_tag</code>, or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">push_repository</code>), the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">includedRefNames</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">excludedRefNames</code> patterns that accept globs plus the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">~ALL</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">~DEFAULT_BRANCH</code> tokens, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">rules</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">bypassActors</code>. <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-ruleset">Create Ruleset</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#update-ruleset">Update Ruleset</a> reject more than 64 patterns per list, 20 rules, or 15 bypass actors with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400).</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#merge-pull-request">Merge Pull Request</a> accepts an optional <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">expectedHeadSha</code> request field, the full commit SHA the pull request&#x27;s head must match. When the head has moved, the merge is rejected with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">ABORTED</code> (HTTP 409 Conflict) and nothing merges; a value that is not a full commit SHA is rejected with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">InvalidArgument</code> (HTTP 400). Omit it to merge whatever the current head is.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Owner references carry a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">type</code> string, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">team</code> or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">user</code>, omitted when Origin cannot resolve it. Returned wherever an <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">owner</code> or installation <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">target</code> appears, including <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-repo">Get Repo</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-repos">List Repos</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-app-installations">List App Installations</a>, and the repository reference on check and pull request responses.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="aug-20-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#aug-20-2026" data-heading-base-id="aug-20-2026" aria-label="Copy link to aug-20-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">August 20, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Breaking.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-pull-request-labels">List Pull Request Labels</a> returns every assigned label in one response and no longer paginates: the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pageSize</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pageToken</code> query parameters and the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">nextPageToken</code> response field are gone. Migration: drop <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pageSize</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pageToken</code> from the request and read the full set from <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">labels</code>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Breaking.</strong> A pull request holds at most 100 labels, and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#add-pull-request-labels">Add Pull Request Labels</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#set-pull-request-labels">Set Pull Request Labels</a> reject a write that would take it past that limit with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">FailedPrecondition</code> (HTTP 400). Migration: keep each pull request at or under 100 labels, removing labels before adding more.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Pull requests carry a <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">labels</code> array of the labels assigned to them, sorted by name and empty when none are assigned. Returned by <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-pull-requests">List Pull Requests</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-pull-request">Get Pull Request</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-pull-request">Create Pull Request</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#update-pull-request">Update Pull Request</a>, and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#merge-pull-request">Merge Pull Request</a>, and included on pull request lifecycle <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#event-payloads">webhook payloads</a>.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="aug-19-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#aug-19-2026" data-heading-base-id="aug-19-2026" aria-label="Copy link to aug-19-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">August 19, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-pull-request-labels">List Pull Request Labels</a> returns the labels assigned to a pull request, ordered by name: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">GET /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/pulls/{pullNumber}/labels</code>. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:pull_requests:read</code></a>. Results are paginated, 30 labels per page by default, and at most 100 labels per page.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#add-pull-request-labels">Add Pull Request Labels</a> assigns existing repository labels to a pull request and leaves the labels already on it in place: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">POST /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/pulls/{pullNumber}/labels</code>. Every label write endpoint requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:pull_requests:write</code></a>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#set-pull-request-labels">Set Pull Request Labels</a> replaces every label on a pull request with the names you send, and an empty list clears them: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">PUT /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/pulls/{pullNumber}/labels</code>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#remove-pull-request-label">Remove Pull Request Label</a> removes one label by name and returns the labels left on the pull request: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">DELETE /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/pulls/{pullNumber}/labels/{labelName}</code>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#remove-all-pull-request-labels">Remove All Pull Request Labels</a> clears every label from a pull request and returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">204</code>: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">DELETE /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}/pulls/{pullNumber}/labels</code>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Label entries carry <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">id</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">name</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">color</code> as a six-character hex value without a leading <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">#</code>, and an optional <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">description</code>. Returned by every pull request label endpoint.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> The <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#rate-limits">app JWT rate limit</a> budget rose from 600 to 6,000 points per minute, and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-installation-access-token">Create Installation Access Token</a> charges 1 point instead of 5, so an app can mint roughly 100 installation tokens per second.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> Owner eligibility for <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-repo">Create Repo</a> and pushes over <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#git-https-authentication">Git HTTPS</a> admits the Pro Student and Start plans alongside Pro, Pro+, and Ultra. Team-owner requirements are unchanged.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> Owner slugs and repository names in <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#repository-paths">repository paths</a> resolve case-insensitively, and responses return the stored casing rather than the casing you sent. <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-repo">Create Repo</a> rejects a name that differs only in case from one the owner already has, so compare repository names case-insensitively.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="aug-17-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#aug-17-2026" data-heading-base-id="aug-17-2026" aria-label="Copy link to aug-17-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">August 17, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Breaking.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#git-https-authentication">Git over HTTPS</a> rejects a push with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">403</code> when the repository&#x27;s owner is not eligible to write to Origin. A user owner must be on a Pro, Pro+, or Ultra plan, and a team owner must have an active paid team plan, must not be on Privacy Mode (Legacy), and must not have Origin turned off by a team admin. Clone, fetch, and pull are unaffected. Migration: handle <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">403</code> on push as an owner-eligibility failure that a retry cannot clear, and confirm the owner&#x27;s plan before pushing on its behalf.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> The first push to a repo created through <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-repo">Create Repo</a> retargets <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">defaultBranch</code> when that push only creates branches and none of them is the stored default: Origin picks the created branch, or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">main</code> or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">master</code> when the push creates several and one of those names is among them. Read the current value from <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-repo">Get Repo</a>.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="aug-16-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#aug-16-2026" data-heading-base-id="aug-16-2026" aria-label="Copy link to aug-16-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">August 16, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Breaking.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-repo">Create Repo</a> rejects a request whose owner is not eligible to write to Origin, returning <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">FailedPrecondition</code> (HTTP 400). A user owner must be on a Pro, Pro+, or Ultra plan, and a team owner must have an active paid team plan, must not be on Privacy Mode (Legacy), and must not have Origin turned off by a team admin. Migration: handle <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">400</code> from <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-repo">Create Repo</a> as an owner-eligibility failure that a retry cannot clear, and confirm the owner&#x27;s plan before creating repositories on its behalf.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="aug-15-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#aug-15-2026" data-heading-base-id="aug-15-2026" aria-label="Copy link to aug-15-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">August 15, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Breaking.</strong> Apps lost access to repositories that Origin mirrors in from GitHub. Those repositories no longer appear in <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-app-installation-repositories">List App Installation Repositories</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-installation-access-token">Create Installation Access Token</a> rejects them in <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repositoryIds</code>, and a request that names one returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">403</code> over both the REST API and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#git-https-authentication">Git over HTTPS</a>. Migration: discover repositories from <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-app-installation-repositories">List App Installation Repositories</a> instead of a stored repository list, and read a GitHub-sourced repository from GitHub rather than the Origin API.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Breaking.</strong> Origin stopped sending webhooks for repositories it mirrors in from GitHub, and installation event payloads dropped those repositories from their selected repository arrays and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repositoriesCount</code>. Migration: source <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events">events</a> for a GitHub-sourced repository from GitHub, and treat an installation payload&#x27;s repository array as the set your app can reach.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="aug-14-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#aug-14-2026" data-heading-base-id="aug-14-2026" aria-label="Copy link to aug-14-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">August 14, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> Revision parameters accept the symbolic <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">HEAD</code> alongside a SHA, branch, or tag: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">sha</code> on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-commits">List Commits</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-commit">Get Commit</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-commit-files">List Commit Files</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-git-commit">Get Git Commit</a>, and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-tree">Get Tree</a>; <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">ref</code> on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-contents">Get Contents</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#batch-get-contents">Batch Get Contents</a>; and either side of <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">basehead</code> on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#compare-commits">Compare Commits</a>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-git-ref">Get Git Ref</a> resolves the symbolic <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">HEAD</code> and returns it as <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">ref: &quot;HEAD&quot;</code> with the tip commit. <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-matching-git-refs">List Matching Git Refs</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-matching-git-refs-by-path">List Matching Git Refs by Path</a> match <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">HEAD</code> exactly, because it does not sit under <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">refs/</code>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> Removing an installation, or deleting the app, invalidates that installation&#x27;s access tokens before <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">expiresAt</code>. The REST API and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#git-https-authentication">Git over HTTPS</a> reject a revoked token with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">401</code>, so an app must be reinstalled before it can mint a working one. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#installation-access-token">Installation access token</a>.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="aug-13-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#aug-13-2026" data-heading-base-id="aug-13-2026" aria-label="Copy link to aug-13-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">August 13, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Breaking.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-contents">Get Contents</a> rejects files larger than 1 MiB (decoded) with <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">FailedPrecondition</code> (HTTP 400), and one oversized file fails an entire <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#batch-get-contents">Batch Get Contents</a> request.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Installation access tokens authenticate Git over HTTPS. Use the token as the HTTP Basic password with username <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">x-access-token</code> against the repository <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">cloneUrl</code>. Clone, fetch, and pull require <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:contents:read</code></a>; push requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:contents:write</code></a>. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#git-https-authentication">Git HTTPS authentication</a>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">cloneUrl</code> carries the GitHub-shaped root path (<code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">https://origin.cursor.com/OWNER_SLUG/REPO_NAME.git</code>) in place of the legacy <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">/git/</code> path, on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-repos">List Repos</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-repo">Get Repo</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#create-repo">Create Repo</a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#list-app-installation-repositories">List App Installation Repositories</a>, and the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository.created</code></a> webhook payload. Both forms clone and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">cloneUrl</code> promises no particular path shape, so a stored value keeps working.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Changed.</strong> <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">size</code> on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#get-contents">Get Contents</a> and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#batch-get-contents">Batch Get Contents</a> responses states the decoded content size in bytes, not the length of the base64 <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">content</code> string.</li>
