</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="aug-11-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#aug-11-2026" data-heading-base-id="aug-11-2026" aria-label="Copy link to aug-11-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">August 11, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Breaking.</strong> Reviewer webhook payloads carry a stable external ID in <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">reviewer.id</code>: the encoded user ID (<code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">user_…</code>, the same format as the organization API) when <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">kind</code> is <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">user</code>, replacing the provider-scoped auth ID; group reviewers keep the group public ID (<code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">grp_…</code>). Affects <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pull_request.reviewer.added</code></a>, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pull_request.reviewer.removed</code></a>, and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#events"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">pull_request.reviewer.rerequested</code></a>. Migration: match user reviewers by the encoded <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">user_…</code> ID wherever your integration compared <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">reviewer.id</code> against stored auth IDs.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Apps can hold up to 10 active Ed25519 signing keys, and <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#app-jwt">app JWT</a> verification accepts a token signed with any active key.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#sync-mirror">Sync Mirror</a> synchronizes one ref of a mirrored repository from its upstream source: <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">POST /v1/origin/repos/{ownerSlug}/{repoName}:syncMirror</code>. Requires <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#scopes"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">repository:contents:read</code></a> and returns <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">200</code> when the sync target is satisfied or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">202</code> while the sync is pending.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Added.</strong> Post-install redirects carry an <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">installation_receipt</code> query parameter: a five-minute Origin-signed JWT that identifies the installation in its <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">sub</code> claim and echoes the publisher&#x27;s <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">state</code> as a claim. Verify it against the published JWKS before trusting the callback. See <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin#installation-receipt">Installation receipt</a>.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Removed.</strong> Origin actor objects no longer include the top-level <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">kind</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">id</code> fields, completing the deprecation announced on <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/api/origin/changelog#aug-5-2026">August 5, 2026</a>. Every <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">actor</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">author</code>, and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">dismissedBy</code> field across check, commit, and pull request responses is affected. Migration: read the <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">user</code>, <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">app</code>, or <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">serviceAccount</code> variant set on the actor.</li>
</ul></div></div></section><section class="border-border border-t py-10 first:border-t-0 first:pt-0"><div class="min-w-0"><div class="mb-8"><div class="min-w-0"><h2 class="text-medium my-0" id="aug-10-2026"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#aug-10-2026" data-heading-base-id="aug-10-2026" aria-label="Copy link to aug-10-2026"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">August 10, 2026</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2></div></div><div class="min-w-0 [&amp;&gt;h3:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;_h3]:mt-8"><ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
